description: This file defines a high-level API class `_Checkpointer` for saving and loading distributed model state dictionaries in PyTorch, interfacing with storage and checkpointing utilities, and providing methods for synchronous and asynchronous save operations.

classes.name: _Checkpointer
classes.description: A class that provides a high-level API for saving and loading distributed checkpoints, abstracting low-level storage operations.

methods.name: __init__( self, storage_writer: StorageWriter, storage_reader: StorageReader, *, process_group: dist.ProcessGroup | None = None, coordinator_rank: int = 0, no_dist: bool = False, load_planner: LoadPlanner | None = None, save_planner: SavePlanner | None = None, )
methods.description: Constructor initializing the checkpointer with storage, process group, and planning configurations.

methods.name: Metadata save( self, state_dict: STATE_DICT_TYPE, )
methods.description: Saves the provided state dictionary synchronously to the checkpoint storage.

methods.name: Future async_save( self, state_dict: STATE_DICT_TYPE, )
methods.description: Initiates an asynchronous save operation, returning a Future that will hold the metadata result.

methods.name: None load(self, state_dict: dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Loads a state dictionary into the model using the configured storage and process group.
